steps.instruction: Heat 1 1/2 cups of vegetable stock until nearly boiling, then keep it hot.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a heavy, medium saucepan.
Add 1/2 large diced onion and a generous pinch of salt.
Cook until the onion is soft and transparent.
Add 1 cup of arborio rice and stir until each grain is coated.
Add 1/2 cup of beer and heat to a simmer, stirring constantly.
When the beer is mostly absorbed, add 1/3 to 1/2 cup of hot stock.
steps.spoken: When the beer is mostly absorbed, add 1/3 to a half cup of hot stock. Stir constantly while simmering. Repeat for around 20 minutes.

steps.instruction: Keep adding hot stock a little at a time until most of it is used up.
Take the pan off the heat.
Stir in 1/4 cup of grated Parmesan cheese until it melts.
Stir in 1/4 cup of shredded sharp cheddar cheese until it melts.
steps.spoken: Stir in the cheddar until it melts. For a cheesier risotto, add more cheese.
